I told Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 382 seats.

That number comes from Tobias's post in #central-team on Oct 14, and no one has posted a different figure there since. Hollis is a member of that channel, so he could see it himself. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to share.

I couldn't check 382 against a contract or account file because I can't see any Marrow files on the share. So I suggested Hollis confirm with Tobias if the account sheet needs to match the paperwork.
